evaluation_recovery.method: Preload and SHA-256 verify owned parent and selected input bytes before restarting the unchanged frozen evaluation; preserve initial logs and exit codes.

evidence.scope: Operator-stored evidence with frozen inputs/numerical sources, all declared evaluations and complete checkpoint receipts. Private keys and Git history are excluded. Weights and Adam states are separate S3 objects.

method.operation: fast.mul_(alpha).add_(parent, alpha=1-alpha), two FP32 CUDA operations
method.optimizer: preserve fast Adam moments, ages and groups exactly
method.selection: first passing alpha in declared descending order; stop after success; no final if none passes

quality.scope: One fixed-size sharded model consolidated from an existing learning update; fresh public task families and retention, not general assistant quality

resources.scope: Planning estimate, not an AWS invoice. Compute includes time through confirmed termination. Network counters include backups and private same-zone traffic, conservatively budgeted at $0.02/GB. Retained S3 storage accrues separately.

scope: One owner, three A10G model shards, one consolidated 1.7B checkpoint. No additional gradient updates, model routing or answer repair. General assistant quality, public artifact availability, useful growth and native serving integration remain unproven by this experiment.
